نستكمن (form X)
# نَسْتَكْمِنُ (nastakminu) /nas.tak.mi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
# نَسْتَكْمِنَ (nastakmina) /nas.tak.mi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
# نَسْتَكْمِنْ (nastakmin) /nas.tak.min/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَكْمَنَ (istakmana)
